title: Identifier
description: The Identifier class represents any identifier issued by any authority, whether a government agency or not. It captures the identifier itself, the type of identifier, and details of the issuing authority, the date on which the identifier was issued.

dateOfIssue.description: The date on which the Identifier was assigned.

issuingAuthorityName.description: The name of the agency responsible for issuing the Identifier.

issuingAuthorityURI.description: The URI of the issuing authority.

schemeName.description: Name of the scheme used to construct the identifier.

schemeURI.description: URI of the scheme used to construct the identifier.

items.description: The value of this property is the Identifier itself.
